_doc: r24 area registry (harness/areas.json): every area of the DERO stack, who owns it in dero-rft §8, the code it covers (repo-relative paths; dir/ prefix, exact file, or fnmatch glob; the most specific pattern wins), its metrics and where each is read, its KAT files, gates, go_mutations id prefixes, dero-rft §7 backlog ids, status, and per-round history. Every measured history value carries an anchor {file, quote, line}: the quote must still be on that line (or, if the line moved, somewhere in the file) or the value is refused (no anchor, no row). The literal "pending" means not measured, with a why. Read and checked by harness/intel/area_intel.py (scorecard, proposals, G23) and KAT harness/kat/test_area_intel_r24.py. Protocol: artifacts/dero-rft.md §0.4.
